name: PicWish
description_en:
PicWish is a photo editing service for background removal, enhancement, object removal and AI-assisted product imagery. It offers web, mobile and desktop routes, but subscription credits, pay-as-you-go credits and batch capabilities are not interchangeable across those platforms.

It fits preparing cutouts or product-photo variations when the user checks the output and the chosen plan. The current subscription matrix lists Pro and Max with recurring credits and separate download allowances; a large-batch desktop claim is not an entitlement of the web Pro plan. Numeric pricing and allowances below use the current pages/browser, not older search snippets.
description_zh:
PicWish提供去背景、增强、对象移除及AI商品图，有网页、移动及桌面路线，但订阅点、随用随付点及批量能力并非跨平台相同。

它适合检查实际输出及套餐后准备抠图/商品变体。当前订阅矩阵列Pro和Max，循环点数与下载额度独立，桌面大批量宣传不是网页Pro权益。以下价格及额度采用当前原页/浏览器，不沿用旧检索摘要。

core_features.explanation_en: Upload/drop/paste an image or URL, inspect edges and refine lighting/shadows/crop or replacement backgrounds.
core_features.explanation_zh: 上传/拖放/粘贴图片或URL，检查边缘并调整光线/阴影/裁切或背景。

core_features.explanation_en: Subscription credits reset without rollover; purchased credits remain valid and have broader platform coverage.
core_features.explanation_zh: 订阅点重置不结转，购买点不失效且跨平台范围更广。

core_features.explanation_en: Subscriptions are single-seat; pay-as-you-go supports shared team credits and seat options.
core_features.explanation_zh: 订阅为单席，随用随付支持共享团队点数及席位选项。

pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 当前年付Pro$59.99(折合4.99)、Max$263.99(折合21.99)，350/2,000月点及独立下载限额；永久购买点/团队/API独立，币种/税费结账未测。

sections.title_en: Prepare the image, then inspect the cutout
sections.en:
The [background page](https://picwish.com/remove-background) accepts upload, drag/drop, paste or image URL and describes edge refinement, lighting, shadows, resizing and background changes. A product-photo workflow should compare cutout boundaries, texture and product color with the original before using generated scenes or relighting. Fine hair/signature claims are vendor claims rather than an accuracy test.

The page advertises up to 100 online images and 10,000 desktop images, while the price page says Free lacks batch and the desktop route is not available under Pro. These are platform/plan-specific capacity descriptions, not a promise that any visitor can batch 100 HDoutputs for free. Choose one intended route and verify its account, file-size and download rules first.
sections.zh:
[去背景页](https://picwish.com/remove-background)接受上传、拖放、粘贴或图片URL，介绍修边、光线、阴影、改尺寸及背景。商品图应先对照原图检查边界、纹理和颜色，再用生成场景/重新布光。发丝/签名精度是厂商主张，不是准确性实测。

页面宣传网页最多100张、桌面10,000张，但价格页Free不含批量，桌面路线又不属Pro。这是特定平台/套餐容量，不保证任何访客可免费批100张HD。应选定路线，先核对账户、文件大小及下载规则。

sections.en:
The current [price page](https://picwish.com/pricing) and browser matrix list Pro 350 recurring credits/month and 50 core-feature downloads/day; Max 2,000 credits/month and 15,000 core downloads/month. The browser annual cards show Pro $4.99/month equivalent billed $59.99/year and Max $21.99 equivalent billed $263.99/year. These are displayed dollar offers; currency/taxes/renewal and other billing periods were not verified at checkout.

Free has limited core downloads/trials, no included credits and no batch. Max lists additional monthly free uses of selected AI/enhancement/removal tools; these are separate from the recurring pool and not unlimited AI generation. Features requiring credits include image enlargement, restoration, text editing/translation and generated scenes. Use the current matrix rather than older 450-credit/single-Pro descriptions from search results.
sections.zh:
当前[价格页](https://picwish.com/pricing)和浏览器矩阵列Pro每月350循环点、每天50次核心下载；Max每月2,000点及15,000次核心下载。浏览器年付卡片Pro折合每月$4.99、年扣$59.99，Max折合$21.99、年扣$263.99。币种符号、税费/续费和其他账期未在结账验证。

Free为有限核心下载/试用，无内含点和批量。Max另列部分AI/增强/移除工具每月免费次数，与循环点池独立，不是AI无限。放大、修复、文字编辑/翻译和生成场景等需点，应采用当前矩阵，不用检索中的旧450点/单Pro描述。

sections.title_en: Credits and seats do not transfer in the same way
sections.title_zh: 点数及席位跨平台方式不同
sections.en:
The [credit article](https://picwish.com/credits-introduce) says purchased credits work on Android, iOS, Windows, Mac and web, while Pro credits work on Android/iOS/web and not Windows/Mac. Recurring credits are used before purchased credits. Current subscriptions are one seat and do not support team mode; pay-as-you-go can share a pool among team seats. API pricing is a separate linked offer.

For a team batch, choose the shared-credit arrangement rather than sharing a personal subscription login. Confirm whether desktop software needs a separate commercial/multi-user license. A mobile “all features” statement does not erase feature costs or desktop exclusions. If a purchase is missing, the credit help recommends checking that the account matches the order before contacting support. No account or credit movement was tested.
sections.zh:
[点数文章](https://picwish.com/credits-introduce)表示购买点可用于Android、iOS、Windows、Mac和网页，Pro点只用于Android/iOS/网页，不含Windows/Mac，且优先扣循环点。当前订阅仅1席不支持团队，随用随付可在团队席共享池，API另有报价。

团队批量应选共享点安排，不共享个人订阅登录，并确认桌面是否需商业/多用户许可。移动“全部功能”不取消操作耗点或桌面排除。购买未到账时，帮助建议先检查登录账户与订单一致再联系支持。本文未测试账户或点数流转。

sections.title_en: Upgrade expiry, trial conversion and refund scope
sections.title_zh: 升级失效、试用转付费及退款范围
sections.en:
The current pricing FAQ says unused recurring credits do not roll over and refresh weekly/monthly from the subscription date. Upgrading starts the new tier immediately, applies remaining monetary value but expires prior benefits/credits; same-tier renewal starts after the current period. Downgrades are not currently supported. Purchased credits do not expire. These are different rules from simply adding another recurring-credit bucket.

The FAQ says trial charges occur after 72 hours and cancellation must be at least 24 hours before the trial/next cycle ends. The [refund policy](https://picwish.com/refund-policy) states seven days for web monthly/annual Pro, three for weekly, and proportional refunds of remaining purchased/API credits within seven days under its conditions. Store purchases follow store channels and exceptions, so no universal full refund is promised. No trial, order, upgrade or cancellation was executed.
sections.zh:
当前价格FAQ表示循环点不结转，按订阅日起每周/月刷新。升级立即启用新档、抵扣剩余金钱价值，但旧权益/点数失效；同档续订等当前期结束再生效，当前不支持降级。购买点不失效，不能把这些都当简单追加循环点桶。

FAQ说72小时后试用扣费，须在试用/下账期结束至少24小时前取消。[退款政策](https://picwish.com/refund-policy)列网页月/年Pro七天、周付三天，购买/API剩余点按条件在七天内按比例退。应用商店走对应渠道及例外，不能保证所有订单全退。本文未试用、下单、升级或取消。

sections.title_en: Desktop software terms are not a blanket web-output license
sections.title_zh: 桌面软件条款不等于网页输出通用许可
sections.en:
The [EULA](https://picwish.com/license-agreement) describes proprietary software, one computer at a time, no simultaneous network use and a required commercial/multi-user license for the stated business scenarios. It is a software license, not proof that every personal web subscription grants identical desktop or client-output rights. Users must clear source images and generated content separately; the credit article disclaims accuracy and third-party-rights guarantees for AI.

Vendor ISO/GDPR/security claims were not independently audited. Exact web/desktop contract interaction, processing retention, commercial scope and unit-credit costs remain open. Preserve originals and permitted outputs, inspect generated detail and use the applicable plan/channel. No installation, photo upload, cutout/enhancement, generated scene, rights clearance or privacy test was performed.
sections.zh:
[EULA](https://picwish.com/license-agreement)描述专有软件、同时1台电脑、不可网络并用，所述商业/多用户场景需相应许可。这是软件许可，不证明每个个人网页订阅同时有相同桌面/客户输出权，源图及生成内容仍需清权；点数文对AI准确性及第三方权利不作保证。

ISO/GDPR/安全声明未独立审计。网页/桌面合同关系、处理保留、商业范围及单操作点价仍待确认。应保留原图和允许输出，检查生成细节并选对套餐/渠道。未安装、上传、抠图/增强、生成场景、清权或隐私测试。
